source: Black Friday: up to 70% off everything.
raw:
{
  "literal": "الجمعة السوداء: خصم يصل إلى 70% على كل شيء.",
  "adaptation": "الجمعة البيضاء: خصم يصل إلى 70% على كل شيء.",
  "back_translation": "White Friday: up to 70% discount on everything.",
  "approach": "adapted",
  "notes": "Changed 'Black Friday' to 'White Friday' (الجمعة البيضاء) because Friday is a holy and blessed day in Islamic culture, making the negative connotation of the color 'black' highly offensive in Saudi Arabia."
}
literal: الجمعة السوداء: خصم يصل إلى 70% على كل شيء.
adaptation: الجمعة البيضاء: خصم يصل إلى 70% على كل شيء.
back_translation: White Friday: up to 70% discount on everything.
notes: Changed 'Black Friday' to 'White Friday' (الجمعة البيضاء) because Friday is a holy and blessed day in Islamic culture, making the negative connotation of the color 'black' highly offensive in Saudi Arabia.
